caption: The drawing shows a standing figure with human-like features, positioned frontally on a rectangular greenish-blue platform. The figure wears a long, reddish-brown robe that covers its body from the shoulders to the feet, with visible arms and hands. The arms are bent slightly at the elbows and sections of the upper arms and forearms, as well as the hands, are depicted in a lighter, almost off-white color, separated by bands of the same reddish-brown as the robe. The figure has bare feet, each foot marked with a red circular spot in the center. The head features long, dark hair, parted in the middle, with a beard and mustache; the face is marked with multiple red streaks or wounds on the forehead, cheeks, and mouth area. There is dark shading under the eyes and on the neck and chin. At the top right of the image, there is a smaller side-view drawing of the same head, showing the profile with similar hair, beard, and facial markings. The overall color palette consists of earthy reds, browns, blacks, and off-whites, with the platform in blue-green tones.
title: Bulto
